'''''Star Wars: Galactic Racer''''' is a [[canon]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Wikipedia:Racing game|racing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[Fuse Games]] and published by [[Lucasfilm Games]]<ref name="Reveal article" /> alongside [[Secret Mode]]. The game was released for [[Wikipedia:Personal console|PC]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 5|PlayStation 5]], and [[Wikipedia:Xbox Series X and Series S|Xbox Series X/S]]<ref name="Reveal trailer /> on [[October 6]], [[2026]].<ref name="Pre-Order Announcement" />

The game's campaign is set in the [[New Republic Era]] and follows the character [[Shade]] through his journey of becoming an elite [[Racer|racing]] [[pilot]] in the unsanctioned racing matches of the [[Galactic League]]<ref name="Reveal article" /> and his quest against his rival [[Kestar Bool]].<ref name="trailer 2 article" /> The [[Wikipedia:Multiplayer video game|multiplayer]] mode will host racing [[Wikipedia:Player versus player|PvP]] matches with one to twelve players. The player will be able to customize their build.<ref name="SecretModeNews">{{WebCite|url=https://wearesecretmode.com/news/star-wars-galactic-racertm-launches-in-2026|text=Star Wars: Galactic Racer™ Launches in 2026|work=[[Secret Mode]]'s official website|archivedate=20251213044840}}</ref>
